stem.text: The flow diagram shows some of the stages in the replication of a lagging strand of DNA.
Which stage of DNA replication uses the enzyme DNA ligase?

A.text: The DNA double helix begins to unwind.

B.text: The single strands of DNA are exposed.

C.text: New complementary DNA fragments are synthesised in the 5′ to 3′ direction.

D.text: The fragments of newly formed DNA are linked together.
